subject: Renewal: Hosted API commit increase & tier ladder for Nimbus Retail
messages:
From: Kate Dawson <kate@nimbusretail.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API renewal & capacity need (Q2 commit increase)

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Quick note from our side as we head into renewal: Nimbus is seeing accelerated usage across recommendations and search personalization. We're running into per-day limits on the current hosted tier and would like to formalize a higher monthly commit and a steeper rate ladder that matches our growth profile.

High-level ask:
- Increase monthly committed tokens from 500M -> 1.4B
- Add a mid-tier rate break at 1.0B with a 20% discount vs baseline
- Extend term from 12 -> 18 months (to lock in pricing while we scale)

Can Redwood provide a revised SOW and redlined T&Cs we can push to procurement? We want to close this before our fiscal month ends (Apr 9).

Thanks,
Kate Dawson
Head of Product Ops
Nimbus Retail
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Kate Dawson <kate@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal & capacity need (Q2 commit increase)

Thanks Kate — good to hear growth is coming through. We can absolutely accommodate an uplift and build a tier ladder that reduces unit cost as you cross thresholds.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Internal pricing + legal to produce a redline and SOW (I'm looping Rishi and Marissa).
2) I'll send a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) outlining milestones for procurement, signed SOW, and billing kickoff so we hit your Apr 9 target.
3) Provide a short test run for the 1.4B projection period with monitored throttles so we can validate latency/latency SLOs under the new commit profile.

Attachments I'll prepare: draft SOW (with term at 18 months), two-tier rate ladder, and redline of Hosted Terms.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Dawson <kate@nimbusretail.com>, procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal & capacity need (Q2 commit increase)

Looping in pricing details and a concrete proposal. Key points:
- Proposed monthly commit: 1.4B tokens (billed monthly, committed).
- Rate ladder (per-1k tokens):
  * 0 - 499M: $0.020
  * 500M - 999M: $0.018
  * 1.0B - 1.4B: $0.014 (mid-tier breakpoint at 1.0B)
- Commit uplift credit: 8% one-time onboarding credit applied after first invoice.
- Term: 18 months with an option to reevaluate at month 12 for a turbo uplift.

I'll attach the redline and SOW draft for legal review. Vanessa — can you confirm whether Nimbus requires a signed PO or if DocuSign is sufficient? That will affect our billing start date.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Commercial Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Kate Dawson <kate@nimbusretail.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal & capacity need (Q2 commit increase)

Thanks Rishi — that ladder looks reasonable and close to what we modeled. A few procurement notes:
- Procurement prefers a DocuSign flow for the SOW + Amendment. PO will follow (our finance team issues POs at the start of the first billing month).
- Can you add a short SLA clause for maximum 99.5% availability on the hosted API path and a documented throttling policy (how you handle per-route spikes)?
- We also need a short annex that documents data residency (US-only) and audit log retention (12 months) for compliance.

If you can send the redline + a MAP with dates, we'll escalate internally and aim to have countersigned SOW by Apr 8.

—Kate
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Kate Dawson <kate@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal & capacity need (Q2 commit increase)

Kate — appreciate the procurement clarity. Attached are: Nimbus_SOW_v2.pdf (draft SOW with 18-month term), redline_hosted_terms.docx (tracked changes), and a one-page MAP. Highlights included per your asks: 99.5% availability SLA for hosted API, a per-route throttling appendix, US-only data residency clause, and 12-month audit log retention.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/packet/ABCD-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/20983

Proposed MAP timeline (high level):
- Apr 5: Redwood sends DocuSign SOW + redlines (today)
- Apr 6: Nimbus procurement completes internal review
- Apr 7–8: Countersign (DocuSign)
- Apr 12: First billing cycle starts / PO issued by Nimbus

If procurement wants a live 30-minute walkthrough of the MAP + throttling appendix we can schedule it tomorrow morning PST. Otherwise, please proceed with the DocuSign route and loop us once countersigned.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nimbus_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW, 6 pages); redline_hosted_terms.docx (terms, tracked changes)
